requirements.title: CloudBase production architecture
acceptanceCriteria: Run API is stateless and production uses CloudBase REST/RPC, private storage and an on-demand Function Worker.
The pre-refactor SHA remains on local and remote recovery branches.

requirements.title: Transactional points and product configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Successful exact/chat generations consume one each and failures consume zero.
The 9.9/50 product and order idempotency are server-authoritative.

requirements.title: WeChat Pay v3 and atomic grant
requirements.limitationReason: The merchant public key and public-key ID are not configured, so a real charge and signed callback require user login to the merchant platform.
acceptanceCriteria: JSAPI signing, raw-body verification, APIv3 decryption and identity/amount checks remain implemented.
Callback and active refresh converge on one atomic RPC and duplicate success grants once.

requirements.title: Private storage and real voice generation
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized video uses signed direct upload up to 100MB.
FFmpeg and Aliyun CosyVoice create private preview, exact and chat audio.
Playback is short-lived and provider IDs are encrypted.

requirements.title: Durable jobs and deletion lifecycle
acceptanceCriteria: API calls do not wait for media work.
Jobs use leases, heartbeats, retries and duplicate-claim protection.
Account deletion finalizes provider and storage deletion before hard cleanup.

requirements.title: Existing mini-program surfaces and authorization types
requirements.limitationReason: All mini-program tests pass, but a deployed page-click and iOS/Android real-device run require an authorized WeChat developer login.
acceptanceCriteria: Login, creation, SELF/OTHER/MINOR authorization, preview, workbench, purchase, voices, account, settings and legal routes retain contracts.

requirements.title: External WeChat launch gates
acceptanceCriteria: Configure merchant public key/ID, complete real login/payment, domain allowlists, device testing and WeChat review.
flows: Real WeChat merchant and device acceptance
